text: Do the buds, having been destroyed by the rains, appear as if they have descended from the mountains? Or do the streams, having been dried up by the heat, seem to have flowed down from the peaks? Or do the branches, stripped of their leaves by the wind, appear as if they have been broken off from the trees? Seeing the faces of the wicked, who have lost all respect and are dancing with their eyebrows raised, driven by the breath of the wind, and whose eyes are filled with the joy of having little wealth, one is filled with sorrow.
